articles.title: Ireland joins the hunt for Russian submarines
articles.summary: The Irish Naval Service faces severe operational challenges, with only four of its eight ships available for duty due to critical personnel shortages. Dubbed "civilian hulls painted grey," its vessels are also ill-equipped. This situation underscores the vital importance of adequate staffing and modern equipment for maintaining effective national maritime defence and operational readiness, a key lesson for aspiring defence personnel.

articles.title: Introducing Beads: A coding agent memory system | by Steve Yegge | Oct, 2025 | Medium
articles.summary: An individual recently completed an intense forty-day ‘vibe coding’ marathon, involving collaborative programming with Thorsten Ball on a beach, complemented by activities like high-speed driving. This unconventional approach highlights dedicated effort in software development, with the full experience illustrated through accompanying visuals.

articles.title: Topiramate protects against neuroinflammation in response to traumatic brain injury via activating Sirt1 signaling
articles.summary: A prospective medical study by Anand, Shahid, and Shameel evaluates the GCS (Glasgow Coma Scale) and FOUR Score's efficacy in predicting mortality for Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) patients. Conducted in a tertiary hospital, this research refines diagnostic tools for severe head injuries. For SSB aspirants, understanding such critical medical assessment methods is vital for potential leadership roles, especially concerning field casualties and emergency medical preparedness.

articles.title: Orange: Orange Board of Directors appoints Frédéric Sanchez as Chairman
articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Orange, a prominent telecommunications firm, announced the appointment of Frédéric Sanchez as its new Chairman on March 20, 2026, in Paris. Sanchez, previously an independent director, will now lead the company. This significant leadership change is crucial for Orange's strategic direction and operations in the competitive global tech and telecom market, impacting its future initiatives and market presence.
